bank_name: Engineers Day 2026 Debugging Arena - Python Problem Bank

problems.title: Average of Three Marks
problems.problem_statement: Read three marks and print their average rounded to two decimal places.
problems.output_format: Print the average with exactly two digits after the decimal point.
problems.buggy_code:
marks = list(map(int, input().split()))
average = (marks[0] + marks[1] + marks[2]) / 2
print(f"{average:.2f}")

bugs.description: The sum of the three marks is divided by 2 instead of 3.
bugs.why_wrong: An average of three values must divide their total by the number of values, which is 3.

problems.corrected_code:
marks = list(map(int, input().split()))
average = (marks[0] + marks[1] + marks[2]) / 3
print(f"{average:.2f}")

problems.title: Count Positive Numbers
problems.problem_statement: Read N integers and count how many of them are strictly positive.
problems.input_format: First line contains N. Second line contains N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the number of positive integers.
problems.buggy_code:
n = int(input())
numbers = list(map(int, input().split()))
count = 0

for number in numbers:
    if number >= 0:
        count += 1

print(count)

bugs.description: The condition includes zero as a positive number.
bugs.why_wrong: The problem asks for strictly positive numbers, so the condition must be greater than zero.

problems.corrected_code:
n = int(input())
numbers = list(map(int, input().split()))
count = 0

for number in numbers:
    if number > 0:
        count += 1

print(count)

problems.title: Discounted Price
problems.problem_statement: Read a product price and discount percentage. Print the final price after applying the discount.
problems.input_format: Two numbers: price and discount percentage.
problems.output_format: Print the final price with two digits after the decimal point.
problems.buggy_code:
price, discount = map(float, input().split())
discount_amount = price * discount
final_price = price - discount_amount
print(f"{final_price:.2f}")

bugs.description: The discount percentage is used directly instead of converting it to a fraction.
bugs.why_wrong: For example, a 20 percent discount means multiplying by 20/100, not by 20.

problems.corrected_code:
price, discount = map(float, input().split())
discount_amount = price * discount / 100
final_price = price - discount_amount
print(f"{final_price:.2f}")

problems.title: Multiples of Five
problems.problem_statement: Read N and print all numbers from 1 through N that are divisible by 5, separated by spaces.
problems.output_format: Print the matching numbers in increasing order separated by spaces. Print an empty line if there are none.

bugs.description: The loop stops at n-1 instead of including n.
bugs.why_wrong: The required range is from 1 through N, so N must be considered.

problems.title: Second Largest Number
problems.problem_statement: Read N distinct integers and print the second largest number.
problems.input_format: First line contains N. Second line contains N distinct integers.
problems.constraints: 2 <= N <= 100; all numbers are distinct and between -10000 and 10000.

bugs.description: The program updates largest before deciding whether the same number should become second, so a new largest can prevent the previous largest from becoming second.
bugs.why_wrong: When a new largest is found, the old largest should move into second before largest is replaced.

problems.corrected_code:
n = int(input())
numbers = list(map(int, input().split()))

largest = max(numbers[0], numbers[1])
second = min(numbers[0], numbers[1])

for number in numbers[2:]:
    if number > largest:
        second = largest
        largest = number
    elif number > second:
        second = number

print(second)

problems.title: Vowel Counter
problems.problem_statement: Read a line of text and count the vowels a, e, i, o, and u. Treat uppercase vowels as vowels too.
problems.input_format: One line containing a string of letters and spaces.

bugs.description: The condition checks only lowercase vowels.
bugs.why_wrong: Uppercase vowels must also be counted, so the input should be normalized or uppercase vowels should be included.

problems.title: Search for a Number
problems.problem_statement: Read N integers and a target value. Print the zero-based index of the first occurrence of the target, or -1 if it is not present.
problems.input_format: First line contains N. Second line contains N integers. Third line contains the target.
problems.output_format: Print the zero-based index of the first occurrence, or -1.
problems.buggy_code:
n = int(input())
numbers = list(map(int, input().split()))
target = int(input())

answer = -1

for i in range(n):
    if numbers[i] == target:
        answer = i

print(answer)

bugs.description: The loop continues after finding the target and overwrites answer when the target appears again.
bugs.why_wrong: The problem asks for the first occurrence, so the search must stop after the first match.

problems.corrected_code:
n = int(input())
numbers = list(map(int, input().split()))
target = int(input())

answer = -1

for i in range(n):
    if numbers[i] == target:
        answer = i
        break

print(answer)

problems.title: Sum of Main Diagonal
problems.problem_statement: Read an N x N matrix and print the sum of its main diagonal elements.
problems.input_format: First line contains N, followed by N lines containing N integers each.
problems.output_format: Print the sum of elements where the row index equals the column index.

bugs.description: The diagonal condition compares i with j+1 instead of j.
bugs.why_wrong: Main diagonal elements have equal row and column indices, so the condition must be i == j.

problems.title: Student Result Calculator
problems.problem_statement: Read marks for five subjects. Calculate the total and average. A student passes only if every subject mark is at least 40. Print the total, average to two decimal places, and PASS or FAIL.
problems.input_format: One line containing five integer marks.
problems.output_format: Print total on the first line, average on the second line, and PASS or FAIL on the third line.
problems.buggy_code:
marks = list(map(int, input().split()))

total = 0
passed = True

for mark in marks:
    total += mark
    if mark < 35:
        passed = False

average = total / 4

if average >= 40:
    result = "PASS"
else:
    result = "FAIL"

print(total)
print(f"{average:.2f}")
print(result.lower())

bugs.description: The fail threshold is 35 instead of 40.
bugs.why_wrong: The stated passing mark for every subject is 40.

bugs.description: The total is divided by 4 instead of 5.
bugs.why_wrong: There are five subjects, so the average must be divided by 5.

bugs.description: The final result is based only on the average instead of requiring every subject to pass.
bugs.why_wrong: A student can have an average above 40 while still having a subject below 40.

bugs.description: The result is converted to lowercase before printing.
bugs.why_wrong: The required output is exactly uppercase PASS or FAIL.

problems.corrected_code:
marks = list(map(int, input().split()))

total = 0
passed = True

for mark in marks:
    total += mark
    if mark < 40:
        passed = False

average = total / 5

if passed:
    result = "PASS"
else:
    result = "FAIL"

print(total)
print(f"{average:.2f}")
print(result)

problems.title: Library Fine Calculator
problems.problem_statement: Calculate a library fine from the number of overdue days. The first 5 days cost 2 per day, days 6 to 10 cost 3 per day, and every day after 10 costs 5 per day. Print the fine.

bugs.description: The first five days are charged at 3 per day instead of 2.
bugs.why_wrong: The first five overdue days cost 2 per day.

bugs.description: Days 6 through 10 are charged at 2 per day instead of 3.
bugs.why_wrong: The second tier has a rate of 3 per day.

bugs.description: Days after 10 are charged at 4 per day instead of 5.
bugs.why_wrong: Every day beyond day 10 costs 5.

bugs.description: A zero-day loan is incorrectly given a fine of 5.
bugs.why_wrong: With zero overdue days, the fine must be zero.

problems.title: Monthly Salary Calculator
problems.problem_statement: Calculate an employee's monthly salary. Basic salary is given. HRA is 20% of basic salary, DA is 10%, and a tax of 5% is deducted from the gross salary. Print HRA, DA, gross salary, and net salary, each with two decimal places.
problems.input_format: One positive number representing basic salary.
problems.output_format: Print HRA, DA, gross salary, and net salary on separate lines.
problems.buggy_code:
basic = float(input())

hra = basic * 10 / 100
da = basic * 15 / 100

gross = basic + hra + da
tax = basic * 5 / 100
net = gross + tax

print(f"{hra:.2f}")
print(f"{da:.2f}")
print(f"{gross:.2f}")
print(f"{net:.2f}")

bugs.description: HRA is calculated at 10% instead of 20%.
bugs.why_wrong: The stated HRA rate is 20% of basic salary.

bugs.description: DA is calculated at 15% instead of 10%.
bugs.why_wrong: The stated DA rate is 10% of basic salary.

bugs.description: Tax is added to gross salary instead of deducted.
bugs.why_wrong: Tax reduces the employee's take-home salary.

bugs.description: The net salary calculation adds tax again instead of subtracting the tax amount.
bugs.why_wrong: Net salary should be gross salary minus tax.

problems.corrected_code:
basic = float(input())

hra = basic * 20 / 100
da = basic * 10 / 100

gross = basic + hra + da
tax = gross * 5 / 100
net = gross - tax

print(f"{hra:.2f}")
print(f"{da:.2f}")
print(f"{gross:.2f}")
print(f"{net:.2f}")

problems.title: Electricity Bill Calculator
problems.problem_statement: Calculate an electricity bill using these slabs: first 100 units at 2 per unit, next 100 units at 3 per unit, and every unit above 200 at 5 per unit. Add a fixed charge of 50. Print the final bill.

bugs.description: The first 100 units are charged at 3 per unit instead of 2.
bugs.why_wrong: The first slab rate is 2 per unit.

bugs.description: The second slab is charged at 2 per unit instead of 3.
bugs.why_wrong: Units 101 through 200 cost 3 per unit.

bugs.description: Units above 200 are charged at 4 per unit instead of 5.
bugs.why_wrong: The third slab rate is 5 per unit.

bugs.description: The fixed charge is 40 instead of 50.
bugs.why_wrong: The specified fixed charge is 50.
